extension: Add new directives as new use cases mature

directives.name: REPOSITORY_INTAKE_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Full governed lifecycle intake of a repository: scan → classify → integrate → monitor
directives.research_requirements: Identify repo purpose, dependencies, tech stack, and open-source license
approval_gates: SECRET_SCAN pass — zero high-severity findings
LICENSE_REVIEW — no GPL contamination for proprietary code
CAPABILITY_FIT — must map to at least one use case
PRODUCTION_REGISTRATION — Nathan review before KG write
directives.validation: Run repo health check; verify KG entity exists; confirm CI/CD green
directives.rollback: Delete KG entity; revert any CI/CD configs; document failure reason
directives.escalation: If SECRET_SCAN finds live credentials → immediately rotate + alert Nathan via Telegram

directives.name: RESEARCH_AND_IMPLEMENT_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Research a domain/tool/technology and implement a production-grade solution if evidence supports it
directives.research_requirements: Minimum 3 independent sources; comparison matrix with >2 alternatives
approval_gates: EVIDENCE_GATE — research brief with evidence table complete
BENCHMARK_GATE — benchmark run and results documented before production deployment
COST_GATE — paid service requires Nathan approval
PRODUCTION_GATE — Nathan approval before any production system changes
directives.validation: Research brief reviewed; benchmark reproducible; implementation health check passes
directives.rollback: Revert implementation; document failure mode; archive research brief
memory_writes: skill registry if new skill identified
use case if new domain covered
directives.escalation: If implementation fails after 2 attempts → pause and request Nathan guidance

directives.name: INCIDENT_REMEDIATION_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Structured detection, triage, diagnosis, fix, post-mortem, and prevention for operational incidents
directives.research_requirements: Collect logs, metrics, and timeline before attempting any fix
approval_gates: TRIAGE_COMPLETE — severity classified before action
ROLLBACK_PLAN — documented before any production change
P1_PRODUCTION_CHANGE — Nathan approval required within 5 minutes
POST_MORTEM — written within 24h of resolution
directives.validation: Service health check passes; root cause in post-mortem; prevention task created
directives.rollback: Execute pre-documented rollback plan; alert Nathan; increment rollback counter
directives.escalation: P1 CashClaw incident → immediate Nathan Telegram alert; halt trading sentinel if spend anomaly

directives.name: SOFTWARE_RELEASE
directives.objective: Deliver a tested, documented, and auditable software release for any Open Empire component
directives.research_requirements: Confirm all deps at required versions; review breaking changes in changelog
approval_gates: TEST_GATE — all unit/integration tests pass
SECRET_SCAN_GATE — zero exposed secrets in release artifact
STAGING_GATE — staging deploy and smoke test pass
PRODUCTION_GATE — Nathan approval for production deploy
directives.validation: Post-deploy health check; smoke tests on production endpoints; version tag confirmed
directives.rollback: git revert + pm2 restart previous version; alert via Telegram; document regression
directives.escalation: If production deploy fails → auto-rollback; alert Nathan; P1 incident protocol

directives.name: CAPABILITY_ACTIVATION_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Full end-to-end activation of a defined capability manifest including all deps, health checks, and KG registration
directives.research_requirements: Confirm all required_repositories, required_services, required_secrets present before start
approval_gates: DEPENDENCY_CHECK — all required services, repos, secrets verified present
STAGING_HEALTH_CHECK — all health_checks green in staging
PRODUCTION_APPROVAL — Nathan approval for production activation
KG_REGISTRATION — capability registered before marking OPERATIONAL
directives.validation: Run all health_checks from manifest; verify KG entity; confirm Mission Control status
directives.rollback: Follow manifest shutdown_order; delete KG entity if registration incomplete; notify Nathan
directives.escalation: If health checks fail after 3 retries → escalate to Nathan; halt activation

directives.name: MODEL_PROVIDER_EVALUATION_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Full benchmarked evaluation of a new inference provider including cost, quality, latency, and security before routing integration
directives.research_requirements: Run minimum 20 benchmark prompts across 3 task categories; compare against Groq baseline
approval_gates: SECURITY_GATE — API key stored in env only; no hardcoding
COST_GATE — Nathan approval if monthly cost >$5
QUALITY_GATE — quality_score must meet baseline before routing
INTEGRATION_GATE — Nathan approval to add to production router
directives.validation: Benchmark report reviewed; provider registered in Free-Way config; test route successful
directives.rollback: Remove provider from router config; delete env var; alert Nathan
directives.escalation: If provider returns >10% error rate → remove immediately; do not activate

directives.name: JOB_ACQUISITION_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Source, screen, customize applications for, and track high-value career/consulting opportunities
directives.research_requirements: Research company culture, hiring manager background, and role-specific tech stack before customizing
approval_gates: SALARY_GATE — no application if salary <floor
QUALITY_GATE — resume ATS match score >75% before submit
SUBMISSION_GATE — Nathan must approve every application before it is submitted
RESPONSE_TRACKING_GATE — Nathan approval before any follow-up outreach
directives.validation: Application log tracked; all submissions Nathan-approved; follow-up scheduled
directives.rollback: Withdraw application if Nathan rejects post-submit; notify recruiter politely
directives.escalation: If salary floor not met → reject automatically and log reason; never submit below floor

directives.name: BLCO_BUYER_QUALIFICATION_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Source, score, and qualify BLCO crude oil buyers through due diligence with Nathan-gated outreach
directives.research_requirements: Verify company registration; check sanctions lists; confirm refinery/trading license
approval_gates: SANCTIONS_CHECK — buyer not on OFAC/EU/UN sanctions lists
LICENSE_CHECK — buyer has valid trading/refinery license
OUTREACH_GATE — Nathan approves every outreach draft before send
LOI_GATE — Nathan reviews LOI before any commitment
FINANCIAL_GATE — Nathan approves any financial document exchange
directives.validation: Lead scored against BLCO_COMMAND.md criteria; outreach log maintained; KG entity created
directives.rollback: Cease outreach; mark lead DISQUALIFIED in pipeline; document reason
directives.escalation: Sanctions hit → immediate halt + alert Nathan; do not send any communication

directives.name: DISASTER_RECOVERY_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Full restoration of Open Empire services and data to known-good state within RTO targets after any failure
directives.research_requirements: Identify failure blast radius before any restore attempt; verify backup integrity
approval_gates: BLAST_RADIUS_GATE — full impact assessment before action
BACKUP_INTEGRITY_GATE — verify backup hash before restore
CASHCLAW_GATE — Nathan manually verifies CashClaw positions before trading restart
PRODUCTION_RESTORE_GATE — Nathan approval for each production service restoration
POST_MORTEM_GATE — post_mortem written within 24h
directives.validation: All PM2 services green; DB integrity check passes; CashClaw positions verified; health checks pass
directives.rollback: N/A — this IS the rollback directive; escalate to Nathan if restore fails
directives.escalation: CashClaw credential compromise → immediate key rotation + Kalshi/Polymarket account lock; Nathan call

directives.name: SSOT_CONVERGENCE_PACKAGE
directives.objective: Converge all Open Empire system state to a single, consistent, committed source of truth with zero orphaned records
directives.research_requirements: Full audit of all canonical repos for uncommitted changes, orphan KG edges, stale memory entries before any writes
approval_gates: AUDIT_COMPLETE_GATE — full divergence report before any writes
SCHEMA_GATE — all records pass canonical schema validation
COMMIT_GATE — Nathan reviews all staged changes before git commit
KG_GATE — orphan edge count =0 before declaring CONVERGED
MIGRATION_UNLOCK_GATE — SSOT_CONVERGED status required before Mac Mini migration proceeds
directives.validation: git status clean on all canonical repos; KG integrity check passes; memory recall test passes
directives.rollback: Revert any premature writes; restore from last known-good backup; re-audit
directives.escalation: If KG corruption detected → halt all writes; run DR-002; alert Nathan immediately
